issue_context.title: Better update frequency for earnings and army graphs
issue_context.body:
At the moment graphs update only once per minute, sometimes averaging the peaks and delaying the event-to-display to the point where it might not be relevant anymore.

Making these update more frequent (i.e. every 15 seconds, so 4 points per minute) will provide much better spectator experience.
